name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 14 – Am 35
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 14a. Calls for EUR 10 million in commitment appropriations for a pilot project testing a SURE-type mechanism in the automotive sector and its component supply chains, providing short-time work and wage support conditional on company transition agreements with trade unions ensuring job retention, paid retraining and productive investment in zero-emission mobility, including affordable vehicles and supplier conversion; calls for public monitoring and recovery of support where commitments are breached, and for safeguards against dividends, share buy-backs and relocation; considers this pilot a first step towards a two-year, EUR 100 billion European SURE instrument for the automotive transition;
